summary.verdict_desc:
**一句话**：AI IPO 管道本周首次冲破 10 家「洪流」阈值、Oracle 旗舰贷款升级为正式不可抗力主张，两条独立恶化线把风险温度推高到 40.0%，但 Anthropic 营收提速打破连续 7 期的数据停滞、恰好抵消了 IPO 那一级恶化，判读维持高风险预警。

**广度与 IPO**：S5FI 由上期收盘 27.83 进一步跌至 9/24 盘中低点 25.44（单日 -11.7%）、9/25 反弹收 26.44，两周跌幅已超三成；全市场约 4750 只股票中仅 28.2% 站上 50 日线（上期 31.4%），广度崩塌未见企稳。同一周 AI IPO 管道从「升温」越过「洪流」门槛：Nscale 9/18 正式向 SEC 递交 S-1（纽交所代码 NSCL）、SoftBank 旗下 SB Energy 9/1 已交表（目标估值约 500 亿美元）、数据中心运营商 Switch 秘密递交（目标 500-800 亿美元），管道内明确处于不同阶段的名字已达约 13 家；与此同时 Anthropic 自己的公开 S-1 截至 9/26 仍未现身 EDGAR、挂牌继续从 10 月推迟到 11 月。市场结构类三项指标本周首次全部亮红，类别分由 83.3 升到 100.0。

**信用面**：Oracle 9/24 就 Project Jupiter 向开发方 Stack Infrastructure 与同时持有该项目债权/股权的 Blue Owl 正式发出不可抗力通知，若 2.45GW 燃料电池电厂与「Green Chile」天然气管道（已推迟至 2027 年 2 月）不能如期到位，租金支付或递延长达三年；项目仅完成约 26%，180 亿美元银团贷款维持 89-91 美分，未进一步下跌，但法律主张本身是升级。压力已外溢到信用提供方股价：Blue Owl 收于 9.32 美元、较 8 月高点跌 27%，Apollo、Blackstone 同步走弱。CoreWeave 的可转债在两周内从最初提出的 30 亿美元一路上调到最终交割的 42 亿美元（超出原计划 40%），Lambda 另完成 9.26 亿美元优先担保贷款——杠杆持续堆叠，但穆迪/标普/惠誉本周仍无一起确认下调或违约，neocloud 维持观察黄灯。

**货币政策**：Fed 理事 Barr 9/23 明确表示「大概率仍需进一步加息」，叠加制造业与服务业 PMI 初值双双升至四年高点，CME 对 10/28 再加息的定价一周内从 59.7% 跳升至 73-76%（部分平台报 85%）；10 年美债 9/26 触及 5.23%，为 2007 年以来最高，较上期 5.006% 继续走高。政策方向本已是红灯，本期是红灯内部的进一步恶化。

**反向证据与机制提示**：本期唯一的好转来自 Anthropic：据 NYT 9/18 报道（经 Bloomberg/Axios 转载），其年化营收步伐预计将在 2026 年内突破 1000 亿美元，较 7 月披露的 650 亿美元在约七周内增长过半，打破了此前连续 7 期「月增量由 170 亿降至 90 亿美元」的停滞读数，二阶导由黄转绿；但 Anthropic S-1 仍处保密状态，这是媒体转载而非公司直接披露。前沿能力方面，Claude Opus 5.5（9/22）与 Grok 4.7（9/21）同周发布，ARC Prize 官网验证 Opus 5.5 在 ARC-AGI-2 拿下 98.5%/93.3%，较此前最佳 73% 大幅跃升，上期「零发布、零 SOTA」的停滞担忧本期解除。值得提醒一处计分机制：本期 trigger 轴分数反而从 46.7 降到 43.3——并非引线在退烧，而是 Fed、Oracle、广度三条 trigger 类指标本期只是「红得更红」（幅度扩大但颜色早已顶格，三色打分捕捉不到红灯内部的强度变化），唯一发生颜色迁移的 trigger 指标恰好是转绿的 arr_2nd_deriv，机械地拉低了均值，不能读作压力真实缓解。

**判读**：红灯 10/25 = 40.0%（上期 36.0%），基础档位直接触及「≥40」门槛，进入高风险预警；同时估值红灯 2 项（CAPE 41.48、前五权重 27.86%）与资金面红灯 3 项（Mag4 FCF、VC 占比、NVDA 客户投资）继续满足①估值+资金面双类共振判据，双重确认同一档位。两轴升级②未触发：stage 65.0（上期 60.0）已达标，但 trigger 43.3 不及 50 的门槛，系统性顶部判据未被触及。加权风险分维持 52.0 不变——ai_ipo_pipeline 由黄转红新增的半分权重，恰好被 arr_2nd_deriv 由黄转绿减少的半分权重抵消，本周是本轮罕见的「结构调仓、总温度不变」的一期。与 2000-02（顶前 1 个月）相似度维持最高 80%，且 IPO 管道本期首次与该时点颜色对齐；仍有的主要差异集中在 NVDA 远期市盈率（约 18.7x 绿灯 vs 当年龙头红灯）、HY 利差（280bps 绿灯 vs 当年黄灯）与基本面六项全绿。本周恶化 1 项、好转 1 项，净 0，未触及 ±4 的边际加速/改善判据。
summary.verdict_desc_en:
**Bottom line**: The AI IPO pipeline broke through the ten-name flood threshold for the first time and Oracle escalated its Project Jupiter loan dispute into a formal force-majeure claim, pushing the risk temperature to 40.0%, but Anthropic's revenue reacceleration snapped a seven-period data freeze and happened to offset the IPO downgrade exactly — the verdict holds at High Risk Alert.

**Breadth and IPOs**: The S5FI breadth index fell from last week's 27.83 to an intraweek low of 25.44 on September 24 (down 11.7% in a single session) before bouncing to close at 26.44 on the 25th, a decline of more than 30% over two weeks; across the broader roughly 4,750-stock universe only 28.2% of names sit above their 50-day average, down from 31.4%, with no sign of stabilization. In the same week the AI IPO pipeline crossed from heating up into flood territory: Nscale filed a public S-1 on September 18 for an NYSE listing (ticker NSCL), SoftBank-backed SB Energy filed on September 1 targeting roughly a $50bn valuation, and data-centre operator Switch confidentially filed targeting $50-80bn, bringing the number of names somewhere in the pipeline to roughly thirteen. Anthropic's own public S-1, by contrast, still hadn't appeared on EDGAR as of September 26, with its listing slipping again from October to November. All three market-structure indicators are now red for the first time, lifting that category's score from 83.3 to 100.0.

**Credit**: On September 24 Oracle sent a formal force-majeure notice on Project Jupiter to developer Stack Infrastructure and to Blue Owl, which holds both debt and equity in the project, seeking room to defer rent by up to three years if a 2.45GW fuel-cell plant and the Green Chile gas pipeline — now pushed back to February 2027 — aren't ready in time. The project is only about 26% complete and the $18bn syndicated loan remains quoted at 89-91 cents, unchanged in price but a real legal escalation. The stress has spread to equity in the credit providers themselves: Blue Owl closed at $9.32, down 27% from its August high, with Apollo and Blackstone also weaker. CoreWeave's convertible bond grew from an initial $3bn ask to a final $4.2bn close, 40% above plan, and Lambda closed a separate $926m secured term loan — leverage keeps building even though Moody's, S&P and Fitch have yet to confirm a single downgrade or default, leaving neocloud credit on watch rather than red.

**Policy**: Fed Governor Michael Barr said on September 23 that "further policy adjustments are likely to be needed," and flash manufacturing and services PMIs hit four-year highs the same week; CME-implied odds of another hike at the October 28 meeting jumped from 59.7% to 73-76% (as high as 85% on some trackers) in a single week, and the 10-year Treasury hit 5.23% on September 26, its highest since 2007 and up from 5.006% last week. The reading was already red; this week it got redder within that band.

**Contrary evidence and a scoring caveat**: The week's one improvement came from Anthropic. The New York Times reported on September 18, picked up by Bloomberg and Axios, that its annualized revenue pace is expected to top $100bn in 2026, up more than half from the $65bn disclosed in July in roughly seven weeks — breaking a seven-period freeze in which the monthly increment had been decaying from $17bn toward $9bn. That figure is media-reported rather than a direct company disclosure, and Anthropic's S-1 remains confidential, so it carries a caveat, but it moved this indicator from yellow to green. On capability, Claude Opus 5.5 (September 22) and Grok 4.7 (September 21) both launched, and Opus 5.5 verified at 98.5%/93.3% on ARC-AGI-2 per ARC Prize's own site, a sharp jump from a prior best near 73%, ending last week's worry about a "double-zero" quarter of no releases and no benchmark movement. Worth flagging: the trigger axis score actually fell this week, from 46.7 to 43.3, even though the Fed, Oracle and breadth stories all intensified — because each of those was already pinned at red and the three-colour scoring can't register a red getting redder, while the only trigger-axis indicator to actually change colour was Anthropic's move to green. That mechanical effect, not an easing of pressure, is what pulled the average down.

**Verdict**: Ten of twenty-five reds gives a 40.0% risk temperature, up from 36.0%, clearing the "40 and above" threshold for High Risk Alert on its own; two valuation reds (CAPE at 41.48, top-five weight at 27.86%) alongside three capital reds (Mag4 free cash flow, AI's VC share, Nvidia's customer investments) independently confirm the same band through the valuation-plus-capital resonance rule. The two-axis override did not fire — stage cleared 65.0 against its 60 threshold, but trigger reached only 43.3 against the 50 required for systemic-top consideration. The weighted risk score held exactly at 52.0: the half-point added when the IPO pipeline turned red was offset one-for-one by the half-point removed when Anthropic's revenue indicator turned green, an unusually clean case of the mix rotating while the aggregate temperature didn't move. Similarity to February 2000 stayed the highest analogue at 80%, and the IPO pipeline's move to red now matches that period's vector for the first time; the remaining gaps are Nvidia's forward multiple (green near 18.7x versus a red multiple then), high-yield spreads (green at 280bps versus amber) and a fundamentals block that is now clean across all six indicators. One indicator deteriorated and one improved this week, a net of zero, short of the ±4 threshold for flagging accelerating deterioration or improvement.

indicators.note: multpl.com 页面顶部读数 41.48（9/25 收盘 4pm EDT，日内 +0.23/+0.56%），较上期 40.94 回升 0.54、结束此前两期的连续小幅回落。仍高于 35 红线约 18.5%，处 1881 年以来 98.8 分位、历史均值 17.42 的 2.38 倍，仅次于 1999-2000 峰值 44.19。
indicators.note_en: multpl.com's headline reading printed 41.48 at Thursday's close on September 25, up 0.56% on the day and 0.54 points above last week's 40.94, ending two weeks of mild pullback. That is roughly 18.5% above the 35 red line, in the 98.8th percentile since 1881 and 2.38 times the 17.42 long-run mean, trailing only the 44.19 peak of 1999-2000.

indicators.name_zh: 标普前 5 大权重占比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >25 red / 18-25 yellow / <18 green
indicators.note: SSGA SPY 官方持仓直读（slickcharts 仍 403，本期 prefetch 未就位改由本地直连 SSGA）：前五单类合计 27.86%（NVDA 8.19 / AAPL 7.38 / MSFT 5.57 / AMZN 3.69 / GOOGL 3.03），较上期 28.01% 小幅回落 0.15pt，NVDA 逆势 +0.12pt 但被 AAPL -0.13pt 等抵消；含 Alphabet 双类 30.29%（上期 30.48%），top10 38.82%（上期 38.49%）。仍是 2000 年峰值约 18% 的 1.55 倍。
indicators.note_en: A direct read of SSGA's official SPY holdings (slickcharts still 403s; this week's automated prefetch hadn't run, so this was pulled directly) puts the top five single-class names at 27.86% — Nvidia 8.19, Apple 7.38, Microsoft 5.57, Amazon 3.69, Alphabet 3.03 — down 0.15pt from 28.01%, as Nvidia's 0.12pt gain was offset by a 0.13pt pullback in Apple. Counting both Alphabet share classes the figure is 30.29% (30.48% prior) and the top ten is 38.82% (38.49% prior). It remains roughly 1.55x the ~18% peak of 2000.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >40 red / 30-40 yellow / <30 green
indicators.note: StockAnalysis 9/25 收盘给出前瞻 P/E 18.68（股价 $225.07，较上期 18.45/$222.27 小幅回升）；FinanceCharts 25.64（9/21 读数，数值未变）、GuruFocus 24.50（连续多周停在 8/19）仍为滞后读数，三源均值约 22.9x。绝对水平仍远低于 1999 年 MSFT 的 60x，是当前向量与 2000-02 最大的一处不同。
indicators.note_en: StockAnalysis puts forward P/E at 18.68 as of the September 25 close (share price $225.07), up slightly from 18.45 on $222.27 last week; FinanceCharts still shows 25.64 (refreshed 9/21 but numerically unchanged) and GuruFocus remains stuck at 24.50 (stale since August 19), leaving a three-source blended read near 22.9x. That stays far below Microsoft's 60x in 1999 — still the single biggest gap between today's vector and February 2000.

indicators.threshold_text: 转折价（低于最近一轮 5%+）或标价明显下跌 红 / 溢价收窄且卖压>买压 黄 / 溢价稳定或扩大 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Marks below last round by 5%+ or clearly falling red / premium narrowing with sellers outweighing buyers yellow / premium stable or widening green
indicators.note: Anthropic 二级报价（StockAnalysis/Hiive 关联口径）$1,050.01/股、隐含 $8885.4 亿，较 $9650 亿 Series H 折价 7.9%（上期 -8.27%，边际连续第 2 周收窄，但已连续第 3 周处于折价）；Forge Global 页面仍未挂出报价（自 5/11 冻结）。OpenAI 侧 Forge $721.85 连续第 5 周逐位未动（suspect_static）。本期最大新进展是叙事而非价格：Anthropic 已把 IPO 由 10 月推迟到 11 月、估值讨论上探 $2 万亿、年底营收目标喊到 $1100 亿，但公开 S-1 至今未见于 EDGAR。因无第二个实时平台确认折价，维持黄灯。
indicators.note_en: Anthropic's secondary mark (via StockAnalysis's Hiive-linked read) stands at $1,050.01 a share, an implied $888.5bn and a 7.9% discount to the $965bn Series H — narrower than last week's 8.27% for a second straight week, but a third consecutive week in discount territory. Forge Global's page still shows no quote for Anthropic, frozen since May 11, and its OpenAI price of $721.85 has been static for a fifth straight week. The bigger development this week is narrative rather than price: Anthropic pushed its IPO from October to November, with valuation talk reaching $2trn and a year-end revenue target as high as $110bn, yet no public S-1 has appeared on EDGAR. With no second live venue confirming a discount, the reading stays amber.

indicators.name_zh: 超大规模厂商资本开支同比
indicators.threshold_text: 下调指引 红 / 加速 黄 / 稳健 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Guidance cut red / accelerating yellow / steady green
indicators.note: 高盛 9/25 把五大云厂商 2027E AI 资本开支预测由上期 $1.01 万亿上调至 $1.2 万亿（同比 +50%，高于市场共识 $1.1 万亿），并指出要回本需要每年约 $3000 亿 AI 收入；追踪的 7 家建设方过去四季度合计资本开支 $6570 亿（Mag4 占 $5430 亿），无一家削减指引，Oracle 维持 FY27 $95B 毛/$70B 净资本开支不变。金额侧 2026E 台账仍是 big4 $7250 亿（+77%）。9/18 定价的 Meta 关联 $12 亿数据中心垂圾债获 4 倍超额认购，显示举债扩产的资金链未断。仍是无一家下调、口径持续上修，加速本身即黄。
indicators.note_en: Goldman Sachs raised its 2027 hyperscaler AI capex forecast to $1.2trn (+50% YoY) on September 25, up from the $1.01trn cited last week and above Street consensus of $1.1trn, while noting hyperscalers need roughly $300bn a year of AI revenue just to break even. The seven tracked AI builders spent $657bn over the trailing four quarters (Mag4 accounting for $543bn), with zero guidance cuts, and Oracle reaffirmed its FY27 $95bn gross / $70bn net capex plan. The dollar ledger otherwise holds at $725bn for big-four 2026 capex, up 77%. A $12bn Meta-linked data-centre junk bond priced September 18 with 4x oversubscription, showing the financing pipeline for expansion remains open. Nobody has cut and every revision keeps going up — acceleration itself is the amber signal.

indicators.threshold_text_en: ≤-20 red / -20 to 0 yellow / >0 green
indicators.note: Q2 硬数据台账不变（Meta $7.84 亿 / AMZN TTM -$76 亿 / MSFT $196 亿 / GOOGL -$58.55 亿），下一读点在 10 月下旬 Q3；但本期分析师把全年预测进一步下修：大摩预计 Amazon 2026 全年 FCF 为 -$170 亿（美银更看空至 -$280 亿），Pivotal Research 预计 Alphabet 2026 全年 FCF 将从 2025 年 $733 亿暴跌近 90% 至 $82 亿。同期 9/18 定价的 Meta 关联 $12 亿垂圾债收益率超 7%、超额认购 4 倍，印证「自身现金流枯竭靠举债续命」；大摩估 2026 年 AI 相关债券发行 $5700 亿，较 2025 年翻倍以上。
indicators.note_en: The hard Q2 print is unchanged — Meta FCF $784m, Amazon TTM -$7.6bn, Microsoft $19.6bn, Alphabet -$5.855bn — with the next real number due with Q3 earnings in late October. But analysts cut full-year 2026 estimates further this week: Morgan Stanley sees Amazon FCF at -$17bn for 2026 (BofA: -$28bn), and Pivotal Research projects Alphabet's FCF collapsing almost 90% to $8.2bn in 2026 from $73.3bn in 2025. Reinforcing the fuel-exhaustion narrative, a $12bn Meta-linked junk bond priced September 18 at yields above 7% with 4x oversubscription, and Morgan Stanley now pegs 2026 AI-related debt issuance at roughly $570bn, more than double 2025.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >50 red / 30-50 yellow / <30 green
indicators.note: PitchBook《Q3 2026 VC Quantitative Perspectives》（9/22 发布）给出 AI 占过去 12 个月（TTM）创投交易额近 80%；注意口径与上期引用的「YTD 65%」不同（滚动 12 月 vs 年初至今），不完全可比，但方向一致、集中度未见缓解。报告同时提出创投「流动性悖论」——退出金额创纪录但基金分配处于历史低位。CB Insights 交叉印证 Q2 单季 AI 占比 >70%、企业投资人占美国 AI 创投交易额 87.9%。无论口径如何，远超 50 红线，红灯不变。
indicators.note_en: PitchBook's Q3 2026 VC Quantitative Perspectives report, published around September 22, puts AI at almost 80% of trailing-twelve-month VC deal value — a different cut from last week's 65% year-to-date figure (rolling twelve months versus calendar year to date), not perfectly comparable but directionally consistent with continued extreme concentration. The report also flags a liquidity paradox: record exit value alongside historically low fund distributions. CB Insights corroborates with AI above 70% of Q2 deal value and corporate investors at 87.9% of US AI VC dollars. Either cut sits far above the 50% red line.

indicators.name_zh: 英伟达客户投资占收入比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >30 red / 15-30 yellow / <15 green
indicators.note: 分母 LTM 收入 $302.97 亿（StockAnalysis，对应 7/26 止 Q2 FY27，与上期 $305 亿基本一致，下次读点 11/17 Q3 FY27）。分子新增具体证据：Nvidia 支持的 AI 云商 Nscale 9/18 提交 IPO 招股书（目标估值 $350 亿），披露 Nvidia 已于 9/15 出资 $31 亿认购可转换票据、另有 $10 亿承诺预计 11 月中到位并于 IPO 时转股——招股书同时披露公司曾有「持续经营重大疑虑」警示。这在已追踪的 ~$400 亿股权承诺（OpenAI $300 亿+Anthropic 最高 $100 亿+xAI 最高 $20 亿）之外新增约 $31-41 亿敞口，广义比率较上期 ~43% 略升。Sona 的 $3.6 万亿循环融资图谱持续引发讨论（Axios 9/21「too interconnected to fail」跟进）。Ohio SPV $1050 亿担保上限本期无变化。
indicators.note_en: NVDA's LTM revenue is $302.97bn (stockanalysis.com, through the quarter ended July 26), essentially flat versus last week's $305bn, with the next print due November 17. This week's concrete new evidence: Nscale, an Nvidia-backed AI cloud provider, filed for a ~$35bn IPO on September 18, disclosing that Nvidia funded $3.1bn of convertible notes on September 15 plus a further $1bn commitment expected mid-November — the same prospectus disclosed a prior going-concern warning. That adds roughly $3-4bn of fresh exposure on top of the ~$40bn already tracked (OpenAI $30bn, Anthropic up to $10bn, xAI up to $2bn), nudging the broad ratio up slightly. Sona Asset Management's $3.6trn circular-financing map continues to draw scrutiny, including an Axios piece on September 21 framing the network as "too interconnected to fail." The $105bn Ohio SPV guarantee cap is unchanged.

indicators.name_zh: 标普 50 日线上方比例
indicators.threshold_text_en: ≤40 red / 40-60 yellow / >60 green
indicators.note: S5FI 由上期收盘 27.83 进一步下探至 9/24 盘中新低 25.44（单日 -11.7%），9/25 反弹 3.93% 收 26.44，周环比再跌约 4.9%；独立宽口径数据源（thetrading.tools）交叉印证：全市场约 4750 只股票中仅 28.2% 站上 50 日线（上期 31.4%）、41.2% 站上 200 日线（上期 43.2%），50 日宽度处历史第 6 百分位。广度持续恶化，本周只是一次性反弹，尚未看到实质性企稳。
indicators.note_en: The S5FI breadth index kept falling from 27.83 last week to an intraweek low of 25.44 on September 24 (down 11.7% in a single session) before bouncing 3.93% to close at 26.44 on the 25th, a further roughly 4.9% weekly decline. An independent broad-universe series (thetrading.tools) corroborates this: only 28.2% of roughly 4,750 US stocks sit above their 50-day average (down from 31.4%) and 41.2% above their 200-day (down from 43.2%), with 50-day breadth now in the 6th historical percentile. Breadth continues to deteriorate; this week's bounce looks like a one-day reprieve rather than stabilization.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >20 red / 5-20 yellow / <5 green
indicators.note: GitHub Actions 定时 prefetch 本期未就位，改为直连 SEC EDGAR 重新聚合 12 家、窗口 8/28-9/27、共 173 份：卖出 $14.128 亿 / 买入 $12.18 万，比值 11595x（买盘近零，value 取上限 99）。卖出绝对额环比 +58.3%（$8.928 亿→$14.128 亿），为台账最高单周读数，主因 Broadcom 单周新增 $2.500 亿卖出（此前两期均为零）与 NVDA 由 $6.607 亿升至 $9.676 亿（+46.5%）；MSFT $6415 万与买盘 $12.18 万均与上期逐位相同，因两周窗口重叠、期内无新增交易所致，非取数失败。结构仍高度集中：NVDA 占 68%、AVGO 18%、AMD 4%。
indicators.note_en: This week's automated prefetch hadn't run, so the reading was pulled directly from SEC EDGAR: aggregating Form 4 filings across the 12-name basket over the August 28-September 27 window, 173 filings in all, gives $1.413bn of open-market sales against $121,844 of purchases, an 11,595x ratio with the buy side capped at 99 in the stored value. Dollar sales rose 58.3% week on week, from $892.8m to $1.413bn, the highest single-week reading in the ledger, driven mainly by Broadcom posting $250.0m of sales (versus zero the prior two weeks) and Nvidia rising to $967.6m, up 46.5%. Microsoft's $64.15m and the full $121,844 of purchases are identical to last week's figures, an artifact of the two overlapping 30-day windows rather than a stalled read. Nvidia still accounts for 68% of total sales, followed by Broadcom at 18% and AMD at 4%.

indicators.value_display: 洪流·首破10家门槛(Anthropic仍推迟)
indicators.threshold_text: 洪流 10+ 红 / 升温 3-9 黄 / 平静 <3 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Flood of 10+ red / heating up 3-9 yellow / quiet under 3 green
indicators.note: 管道本期首次越过「洪流」阈值：Nscale 9/18 正式向 SEC 递交 S-1（纽交所 NSCL，GS/JPM/MS 主承销）；SoftBank 旗下 SB Energy 9/1 已交表（目标估值约 $500 亿，H1 净亏 $32 亿但合同储备 $4390 亿）；数据中心运营商 Switch 已秘密递交（目标 $500-800 亿，最快 11 月挂牌）。加上 Vantage（探索中，约 $1000 亿）、CyrusOne（2027 年）、Blue Owl DC REIT、DataBank、EdgeCore、DayOne（秘密递交）、Lambda（洽谈 $30 亿 Pre-IPO 轮）、Crusoe（评估中）、Cerebras（已挂牌），管道内不同阶段的名字已达约 13 家，首次突破 10 家红线。与此形成对照：Anthropic 自己的公开 S-1 截至 9/26 仍未现身 EDGAR，挂牌继续从 10 月推迟到 11 月；OpenAI 明确表示 2026 年内不会上市。
indicators.note_en: The pipeline crossed the ten-name flood threshold for the first time this week. Nscale publicly filed its S-1 on September 18 for an NYSE listing (ticker NSCL; Goldman, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley as bookrunners); SoftBank-backed SB Energy filed on September 1 targeting roughly a $50bn valuation (a $3.2bn H1 net loss against just $139m of revenue, but a $439bn contract backlog); and data-centre operator Switch confidentially filed targeting $50-80bn, with a possible November listing. Add Vantage (exploring, ~$100bn), CyrusOne (targeting 2027), a Blue Owl data-centre REIT, DataBank, EdgeCore, DayOne (confidential filing), Lambda (raising a $3bn pre-IPO round), Crusoe (evaluating) and the already-public Cerebras, and roughly thirteen names now sit somewhere in the pipeline. By contrast, Anthropic's own public S-1 still hadn't appeared on EDGAR as of September 26, its listing slipping again from October to November, and OpenAI's Altman said explicitly there will be no 2026 listing.
indicators.value_display_en: Flood, first time past 10 (Anthropic still delayed)

indicators.name_zh: 高收益债期权调整利差
indicators.threshold_text_en: >500 red / 350-500 yellow / <350 green
indicators.note: FRED API key 本期不可用，改用 FRED 官方网页快照：BAMLH0A0HYM2 = 280bps（观测日 9/24），较上期 270bps 走阔 10bps；TradingEconomics 与 govspending.org 镜像同源同值，交叉印证成立；Convex 镜像 9/21 读数 266bps 略低，方向一致抬升。距 350 黄线仍有 70bps 空间，绿灯不变——指数级信用仍与项目级信用（Oracle 贷款、breadth 崩塌）的裂化脱钩。
indicators.note_en: With the FRED API key unavailable this week, the reading comes from FRED's own webpage snapshot: BAMLH0A0HYM2 stood at 280bps as of the September 24 observation, up 10bps from 270 last week, cross-checked against matching prints on TradingEconomics and govspending.org; Convex's mirror showed 266bps on September 21, consistent with a modest recent widening. That leaves 70bps of room before the 350 amber line, so the reading stays green — index-level credit remains decoupled from the cracks showing at the project level (the Oracle loan, collapsing breadth).

indicators.name_zh: 数据中心 ABS 利差
indicators.value_display: 走阔·Oracle发正式不可抗力通知
indicators.threshold_text: 走阔 50bps+ 红 / 稳定 黄 / 收窄 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: 50bps+ wider red / stable yellow / tighter green
indicators.note: 本期由「贷款折价」升级为「正式法律主张」：Oracle 9/24 就 Project Jupiter 向开发方 Stack Infrastructure 与同时持有该项目债权/股权的 Blue Owl 正式发出不可抗力通知，若 2.45GW 燃料电池电厂与「Green Chile」天然气管道（已推迟至 2027 年 2 月）不能如期到位，租金支付或递延长达三年；新墨西哥州最高法院 9/17 已解除许可禁令，但项目仅完成约 26%、落后原计划 7 个月，$180 亿银团贷款维持 89-91 美分（与上期持平，未进一步下跌）。压力已外溢到信用提供方股价：Blue Owl 收 $9.32（较 8 月高点 -27%），Apollo $121、Blackstone $118 同步走弱。Data Center Watch 统计 Q2 单季 $680 亿数据中心项目因当地反对被阻或延后，H1 累计近 $2000 亿。一级市场未关门：Blackstone/QTS 约 $10 亿数据中心 ABS（7 座超大规模数据中心）Fitch 已出预评级，预计 10/5 当周完成。
indicators.note_en: This escalated this week from a loan trading at a discount to a formal legal claim: around September 24 Oracle sent a force-majeure notice on Project Jupiter to developer Stack Infrastructure and to Blue Owl, which holds both debt and equity in the project, seeking room to defer rent by up to three years if a 2.45GW fuel-cell plant and the Green Chile gas pipeline — now pushed to February 2027 — aren't ready in time. New Mexico's Supreme Court lifted a permit stay on September 17, but the project is only about 26% complete and seven months behind, with the $18bn syndicated loan still quoted at 89-91 cents, unchanged in price but not in legal posture. The stress has spread to equity in the credit providers: Blue Owl closed at $9.32 (down 27% from its August high), with Apollo at $121 and Blackstone at $118 also weaker. Data Center Watch counted $68bn of data-centre projects blocked or delayed by local opposition in Q2 alone, nearly $200bn for H1. Primary issuance hasn't frozen: Blackstone's QTS has a roughly $1bn data-centre ABS deal (seven hyperscale facilities) with a Fitch presale out, expected to close the week of October 5.
indicators.source_name: El Paso Matters / KRWG / CNBC / Benzinga
indicators.value_display_en: Widening, Oracle files formal force majeure

indicators.value_display: 观察(0起评级动作·杠杆再抬升)
indicators.threshold_text: 已确认事件 红 / Watch 评级 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Confirmed event red / on watch yellow / none green
indicators.note: 本期仍无穆迪/标普/惠誉对 CoreWeave、Nebius、Nscale、Lambda、Crusoe 的评级下调、违约或不良交换确认行动，维持观察黄灯。但杠杆持续攀升：CoreWeave 可转债从最初提出的 $30 亿（9/17）两次上调，最终于 9/22 交割前定于 $42 亿（超原计划 40%），2033 年到期、票息 2.875%、转股价约 $97.85（较 9/17 收盘 $79.88 溢价 22.5%），使其 2026 年以来累计可转债发行超 $100 亿；现有 DDTL 5.0 贷款评级仍是 Ba2(穆迪)/BB+(惠誉)，投机级未变。Lambda 另于 9/22 完成 $9.26 亿优先担保 Term Loan B，为一家投资级客户的 GPU 部署融资。市场仍在用股价、转股溢价与信贷利差定价压力，评级机构尚未跟进。
indicators.note_en: No Moody's/S&P/Fitch downgrade, default, or distressed exchange has been confirmed this week for CoreWeave, Nebius, Nscale, Lambda, or Crusoe, so the reading stays on watch. Leverage keeps building, though: CoreWeave's convertible, first floated at $3.0bn on September 17, was upsized twice and closed at a final $4.2bn on September 22 — 40% above the original target — due 2033 at a 2.875% coupon with a conversion price near $97.85, a 22.5% premium to the September 17 close, taking its cumulative 2026 convertible issuance past $10bn. Its existing DDTL 5.0 facility remains Ba2 (Moody's) / BB+ (Fitch), unchanged and sub-investment-grade. Separately, Lambda closed a $926m senior secured Term Loan B on September 22 backing GPU deployment for an investment-grade customer. Equity and credit markets are still pricing the stress; the rating agencies have not yet followed.

indicators.name_zh: 全口径债务/Capex 流量比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >70 red / 50-70 yellow / <50 green
indicators.note: 周度增量：CoreWeave 可转债在两周内从最初 $30 亿一路上调至 9/22 最终交割的 $42 亿（超原计划 40%，较上期记录的 $37 亿再上修 $5 亿）；另新增 Lambda $9.26 亿优先担保 Term Loan B（9/22 交割，为一家投资级客户的 GPU 部署融资）。无单笔 ≥$100 亿新 deal。台账可追溯流水由 $2087.2 亿升至 $2101.5 亿、20 笔（含在市未定价的 Broadcom $700 亿）。分子仍沿用 9/6 完整对账中枢 $6000 亿（区间 $5700-6500 亿），分母 $1.08 万亿 → 比值 55.6%，取 56%，与上期持平。交叉印证：高盛 9/25 将 2027E 全行业 hyperscaler capex 预测由 $1.01 万亿上调至 $1.2 万亿（+50%），分母侧仍在加速抬升，若对账跟不上 capex 扩张步伐，比值有被动走低的风险。距 70% 红线 14pt，下次完整对账 10/4 后进行。
indicators.note_en: Weekly increment: CoreWeave's convertible grew over two weeks from an initial $3.0bn ask to a final $4.2bn close on September 22 (40% above plan, $0.5bn above last week's recorded $3.7bn); a new deal was added, Lambda's $926m senior secured Term Loan B closed September 22 backing GPU deployment for an investment-grade customer. No single deal reached the $10bn threshold this week. The traceable ledger total rises from $208.7bn to $210.1bn across 20 deals, including Broadcom's still-unpriced $70bn in-market deal. The numerator still carries the September 6 full reconciliation's $600bn midpoint (range $570-650bn) against a $1.08trn denominator, giving 55.6%, rounded to 56% and unchanged from last week. Cross-check: Goldman raised its 2027E hyperscaler capex forecast to $1.2trn (+50%) on September 25, up from $1.01trn last week, so the denominator keeps accelerating too — if the ledger can't keep pace with capex growth, the ratio risks drifting lower on its own. Fourteen points below the 70% red line, with the next full reconciliation due after October 4.

indicators.name_zh: 行业 Token 量月度环比
indicators.threshold_text: 收缩 红 / 减速 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Contracting red / decelerating yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: 沿用 2026-09-19 值（数据源暂不可用）：OpenRouter 官方 datasets API 本期需 Bearer token 鉴权，沙箱与直连均未获取到有效凭证；本应于本次 routine 运行前 2 小时完成的 GitHub Actions 定时 prefetch，截至运行时仍未触发/未推送，prefetch 文件仍是上上期 9/20 快照，已超 3 天新鲜度窗口不可用；备源（openrouter.ai/rankings 页面）为客户端渲染、无法解析出底层绝对量。value 沿用 +74.2%、as_of 保留 2026-09-19，不前移。
indicators.note_en: Carrying the value as of 2026-09-19 (source unavailable): OpenRouter's official datasets API requires bearer-token authentication that neither this sandbox nor a direct call could supply this week, and the scheduled GitHub Actions prefetch — normally due two hours before this routine runs — had not fired or pushed by run time, leaving the prefetch file at last week's September 20 snapshot, past the 3-day freshness window. The documented backup, the openrouter.ai/rankings page, is client-rendered and does not expose the underlying absolute token counts. The value stays at +74.2% and as-of remains September 19.

indicators.value_display: 稳定·中位价持平,另一指数月环比+22%
indicators.threshold_text: 环比跌 >15% 或普遍过剩 红 / 温和阴跌·空置上升 黄 / 稳定或紧俏 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Down 15%+ or broad oversupply red / mild drift lower with rising vacancy yellow / stable or tight green
indicators.note: AIMultiple 指数 9/22 更新的 H100/H200/B200 中位租金（$3.25/$4.40/$6.52/hr）与前一周快照完全相同，价格持稳无新变化；另一独立指数（Ornn，经 SemiAnalysis 生态引用）显示 H100 价格截至 9/7 月环比 +22% 至 $3.28/hr，方向是涨、与「供过于求」叙事相反。旧代 GPU（V100/P100/K80）从 $1.77 跌至 $0.95，但不影响主流芯片判读。可用性方面 MI300X 仅 7%、B300 11%、H100 33%，与上周一致，新一代芯片仍紧张，无 >15% 跌幅证据。
indicators.note_en: AIMultiple's September 22 refresh shows H100/H200/B200 medians unchanged from the prior week's snapshot ($3.25/$4.40/$6.52/hr), while a separate index (Ornn, cited within the SemiAnalysis ecosystem) shows H100 up 22% month over month to $3.28/hr as of September 7 — the opposite of an oversupply signal. Legacy GPUs (V100/P100/K80) have fallen from $1.77 to $0.95/hr, but that sits outside the tracked frontier SKUs. Availability for new silicon remains tight (MI300X 7%, B300 11%, H100 33%), identical to last week, with nothing close to a 15% price decline.
indicators.value_display_en: Stable, median flat; separate index +22% MoM

indicators.threshold_text: 减速 红 / 平稳 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Decelerating red / flat yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: 打破连续 7 期数据停滞：据 NYT 9/18 报道（经 Bloomberg/Axios 转载），Anthropic 年化营收步伐预计将在 2026 年内突破 $1000 亿，较 7 月披露的 $650 亿在约七周内增长过半，隐含月增量约 $17.5-23 亿，高于此前「$170 亿→$90 亿」的衰减读数，指向重新加速而非减速。需要注意：此数字来自媒体转载而非公司直接对投资者的披露（不同于 7 月 $650 亿那次），且 Anthropic 公开 S-1 截至 9/23（Forbes）仍处保密提交状态、未见于 EDGAR，IPO 窗口已从 10 月推迟到 11 月。OpenAI 侧无新数据，仍锚定 8 月的 $400 亿。综合看，Anthropic 一侧的加速信号足以将本指标由黄转绿，但可信度略低于公司直接披露，需下期 S-1 公开后核实。
indicators.note_en: This breaks a seven-period stale streak: the New York Times reported on September 18 (picked up by Bloomberg and Axios) that Anthropic's annualized revenue pace is expected to top $100bn in 2026, up more than half from the $65bn disclosed in July in roughly seven weeks, implying a monthly increment near $17.5-23bn versus the prior decaying pattern of $17bn down to $9bn — reacceleration rather than deceleration. The caveat: this figure is media-reported rather than a direct investor disclosure like July's $65bn, and Anthropic's S-1 remained confidential as of a September 23 Forbes report, not yet on EDGAR, with the IPO window now slipping to November. OpenAI has no new figure and stays anchored at $40bn (August). The Anthropic-side signal is enough to move this from yellow to green, but with lower confidence than a direct disclosure, pending confirmation once the S-1 goes public.

indicators.threshold_text_en: ≤50 red / 50-65 yellow / >65 green
indicators.note: 本周未检索到 McKinsey、Gartner、IDC 或 Deloitte 发布的新一期企业 AI 部署调查。重新核实的数字与上期一致：McKinsey Q1 2026 的 72% 续为主锚（2024 年 55%），Presenc AI Global 2000 口径 78%；Gartner/IDC 侧数字同样未变（80% 企业应用嵌入 agent，仅 31% 真正投产；预计 2026 年底 40% 企业应用带任务型 agent）。Deloitte 2026 年度报告基础调研实际完成于 2025 年 8-9 月，非本周新数据。部署广、价值捕获窄的裂口仍在，但采用率本身离 65% 黄线还有 7pt，绿灯不变。
indicators.note_en: No fresh McKinsey, Gartner, IDC or Deloitte enterprise-AI deployment survey was published this week. Re-verified figures match last week: McKinsey's 72% from Q1 2026 remains the anchor (versus 55% in 2024), with Presenc AI's 78% Global 2000 figure also unchanged, and the same Gartner/IDC data points hold (80% of enterprise apps embed an agent, yet only 31% actually run one in production; 40% expected to carry task-specific agents by end of 2026). Deloitte's 2026 annual report is built on a survey fielded in August-September 2025, so it isn't new data either. The gap between broad deployment and narrow value capture persists, but adoption itself sits seven points clear of the 65% amber line and the reading stays green.

indicators.value_display: 强劲·连续第2期无新读数
indicators.threshold_text: 负增长 红 / 减速 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Negative red / decelerating yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: 沿用 2026-09-10 值（数据源暂不可用）：本期仍无 Oracle、Microsoft、Google、AWS 任何新季度 RPO/backlog 披露，连续第 2 期无新读数，as_of 不前移。台账维持：Oracle Q1 FY27 RPO $6640 亿（+46% YoY）、OCI 收入 +121%；MSFT 商业 RPO $6780 亿（+84% YoY）；AWS $4960 亿（久期 6.4 年）；Google backlog $5140 亿，四家合计约 $2.3 万亿。搜索中出现的其他数字（如 Oracle $4550 亿/$6380 亿）核实后均为不同财季的旧报道，非本期新披露，已剔除。下一批硬数据集中在 10 月下旬至 11 月初（MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN Q3），Oracle 下一次约在 12 月。
indicators.note_en: Carrying the value as of 2026-09-10 (source unavailable): no new quarterly RPO or backlog disclosure has surfaced from Oracle, Microsoft, Google, or AWS for a second straight period, so the as-of date does not roll forward. The ledger holds — Oracle's Q1 FY27 RPO of $664bn (+46% YoY) with OCI revenue up 121%; Microsoft's commercial RPO of $678bn (+84% YoY); AWS at $496bn (6.4-year duration); and Google's $514bn backlog, roughly $2.3trn combined. Other figures turned up by search (Oracle at $455bn or $638bn) trace back to different, older fiscal-quarter reports and were discarded as not new. The next batch of hard numbers arrives in late October/early November (Microsoft, Google, Amazon Q3) with Oracle's next print around December.
indicators.value_display_en: Strong, 2nd straight period without new data

indicators.threshold_text: 连续两季无实质提升 红 / 提升有限·倍增拉长 黄 / 90 天内困难基准实质刷新 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Two quarters without material gains red / limited gains with lengthening doubling time yellow / a hard benchmark materially refreshed within 90 days green
indicators.note: 上期报告的「零发布、零 SOTA」未能延续。Anthropic 9/22 发布 Claude Opus 5.5、xAI 9/21 发布 Grok 4.7；ARC Prize 官网 9/22 验证 Opus 5.5 在 ARC-AGI-2 拿下 98.5%（v1 半私有集）/93.3%（v2 半私有集），较此前最佳 ~73%（独立方案）大幅跃升，接近该基准饱和。HLE（带工具）方面 Opus 5.5 以 67.7% 小幅超越 Fable 5.1 的 65.6%，刷新该子榜 SOTA。ARC-AGI-3 仍是 GPT-6 Astra 62.7%（Opus 5.5 尚未跑该榜）、FrontierMath Tier-4 仍是 GPT-6 Astra 自报 97.6%（Epoch 官方独立验证上限仍为 87.8%，未变），METR 时间跨度页面自 5/8 起未再更新。本期有实质、可查日期的能力进展（尤其 ARC-AGI-2），绿灯不变，上期「停滞观察」的担忧本期解除。
indicators.note_en: Last week's report of a "double-zero" week — no releases, no SOTA moves — did not repeat. Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5.5 on September 22 and xAI shipped Grok 4.7 on September 21. ARC Prize's own site verified on September 22 that Opus 5.5 scores 98.5% (ARC-AGI-2 v1 semi-private) and 93.3% (v2 semi-private), a large jump from the prior best of roughly 73% (an independent solver), pushing this benchmark toward saturation. On HLE (tools-enabled), Opus 5.5's 67.7% edges out Fable 5.1's 65.6% for a new sub-leaderboard SOTA. ARC-AGI-3 remains unchanged at 62.7% (GPT-6 Astra; Opus 5.5 hasn't been scored there yet), FrontierMath Tier-4 is still GPT-6 Astra's self-reported 97.6% (Epoch's independently verified ceiling stays at 87.8%), and METR's time-horizon page hasn't added a point since May 8. There was genuine, dated capability progress this week, especially on ARC-AGI-2, so green holds and last week's stalling concern is defused for now.
indicators.source_name: ARC Prize / Anthropic / xAI / Epoch AI / METR
indicators.value_display_en: Accelerating, two flagship releases + new ARC-AGI-2 SOTA

indicators.name_zh: 会计造假/循环交易事件
indicators.value_display: 0 (Burry新增具体数字·Nscale披露持续经营疑虑)
indicators.threshold_text: 已确认 红 / 调查中 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Confirmed red / under investigation yellow / none green
indicators.note: 仍无针对 AI 龙头的已确认会计造假认定或 SEC 执法立案，计数 0，绿灯不变。但争议进一步具体化：Michael Burry 9/24-25 发布最新分析，列出各厂商未起租/未确认租约义务规模——Alphabet 约 $9000 亿、Meta 约 $7000 亿、Microsoft 超 $3000 亿（近期几乎翻三倍）、Amazon $2670 亿（9 个月内 +81%），并批评微软将数据中心资产使用寿命由 15 年延长至 25 年「太精明了」。同期 Nscale 的 $350 亿 IPO 招股书披露此前存在「持续经营」重大疑虑，靠 Nvidia 9/15 的 $31 亿可转债贷款才暂时缓解——这是本期唯一带具体名字的会计/披露警示，但仍属合规披露范畴而非坐实造假。
indicators.note_en: No confirmed accounting fraud finding or SEC enforcement action against a major AI company surfaced this week, so the count stays at zero and the reading stays green. But the debate got more specific: Michael Burry's September 24-25 post cited fresh uncommenced-lease figures — Alphabet roughly $900bn, Meta about $700bn, Microsoft over $300bn (roughly tripled recently), and Amazon $267bn (up 81% in nine months) — and called Microsoft's extension of data-centre useful life from 15 to 25 years "too cute by half." Separately, Nscale's $35bn IPO prospectus disclosed a prior going-concern doubt, eased only by Nvidia's $3.1bn convertible loan on September 15 — the first named, concrete disclosure-risk item this period, though still compliant disclosure rather than a fraud finding.
indicators.value_display_en: 0 (Burry cites new specifics; Nscale discloses going-concern doubt)

indicators.threshold_text: 隐含加息 红 / 维持高利率 黄 / 隐含降息 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Hike priced in red / on hold at high rates yellow / cut priced in green
indicators.note: Fed 理事 Michael Barr 9/23 明确表态「大概率仍需进一步加息」以压制顽固通胀，叠加标普全球制造业与服务业 PMI 初值双双升至四年多高点；CME FedWatch 对 10/28 再加息 25bp 的定价一周内从上期 59.7% 跳升至 73-76%（部分平台报 85%）。10 年美债 9/26 触及 5.23%，为 2007 年以来最高，较上期 5.006% 继续走高。政策方向已是红灯，本期是红灯内部幅度的进一步恶化。
indicators.note_en: Fed Governor Michael Barr said on September 23 that "further policy adjustments are likely to be needed" to bring down sticky inflation, and flash S&P Global manufacturing and services PMIs hit four-year-plus highs the same week. CME FedWatch-implied odds of another 25bp hike at the October 28 meeting jumped from 59.7% last week to 73-76% (as high as 85% on some trackers). The 10-year Treasury hit 5.23% on September 26, its highest since 2007, up from 5.006% last week. The reading was already red; this week is a worsening within that band rather than a new trigger.

indicators.name_zh: 资本开支指引市场反应
indicators.threshold_text: 系统性惩罚 红 / 偶发惩罚 黄 / 奖励 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Systematic punishment red / occasional punishment yellow / rewarded green
indicators.note: 反应本期继续分化而非全面遭抛售，与上期结论一致。Oracle 9/24 再跌 6% 至 $136.73（呼应上期 9/18 的 -3.8%，均属公司特定的现金流/债务成本担忧——营运现金流 $230 亿但自由现金流 -$54 亿，利息费用同比 +55% 至 $14 亿），同期 CoreWeave 几乎持平、Snowflake 仅跌 1%、云计算 ETF（SKYY）持平，惩罚仍局限于 Oracle 个股。与此同时纳指 9/22 创收盘新高（+2.3%）：美光（+2.4%，分析师上调评级）、AMD（+10%，市值突破 $1 万亿）、Intel（+12%）均因 AI 芯片/内存需求乐观情绪大涨，Meta 因新推出的 AI 购物助手 Muse 走红而股价飙升——表明只要需求叙事可信，capex/AI 新闻仍能获得奖励。维持黄灯不变。
indicators.note_en: Reaction stayed selective this week rather than becoming systematic, the same conclusion as last week. Oracle fell another 6% on September 24 to $136.73 (echoing last week's 3.8% drop, both driven by company-specific balance-sheet concerns — negative $5.4bn free cash flow despite $23bn of operating cash flow, and interest expense up 55% YoY to $1.4bn), while CoreWeave was flat, Snowflake down just 1%, and the SKYY cloud ETF unchanged — the punishment stayed isolated to Oracle. Simultaneously the Nasdaq hit a record close (+2.3%) on September 22 as Micron (+2.4% on analyst upgrades), AMD (+10%, market cap crossing $1trn) and Intel (+12%) rallied on AI chip/memory demand optimism, and Meta jumped on its new Muse AI shopping agent's early traction. Capex/AI-demand news is still rewarded when the growth story is credible. The indicator holds at yellow.

indicators.value_display: 分化持续·黄仁勋再反驳+特朗普称阴谋论
indicators.threshold_text: 普遍承认过热 红 / 部分对冲 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Broad acknowledgement of overheating red / partial hedging yellow / none green
indicators.note: 本周未出现 CEO 对 AI 泡沫的新一轮广泛承认，维持黄灯，与上期基本持平。黄仁勋 9/25 在 CNN/Ezra Klein 访谈中继续反驳「AI 失控」说法，直言 OpenAI「没有钱」（收入仅百亿美元级却要支撑万亿级基础设施），延续其反泡沫叙事；同一周特朗普将 AI 安全担忧称为「针对 AI 和数据中心的阴谋」，呼应黄仁勋立场，形成官方+行业双重压泡沫叙事的新组合。9/24 白宫特朗普-习近平国宴上奥特曼、黄仁勋、库克、马斯克等确认出席，但公开报道未见任何关于泡沫/估值的实质发言。背景：9/14 Anthropic 的 Amodei 联合马斯克、Hassabis、奥特曼呼吁「放慢前沿模型开发步伐」曾一度打压 AI 股，但该事件发生在本观察窗口之前，仅作背景不计入本期新增证据。
indicators.note_en: No new broad wave of CEO bubble acknowledgment emerged this week, so the reading holds at yellow, largely flat versus last week. Jensen Huang doubled down on his pushback in a CNN/Ezra Klein interview aired September 25, bluntly saying OpenAI "has no money" — low-double-digit-billion revenue against trillion-dollar infrastructure needs — continuing to dismiss the "AI out of control" framing. In the same week, Trump called AI safety worries "a conspiracy against AI and data centers," echoing Huang's dismissiveness, a notable new pairing of political and industry pushback. Altman, Huang, Cook, Musk and others attended the Trump-Xi state dinner on September 24, but no reported remarks there touched bubble or valuation risk. For context, Anthropic's Dario Amodei led a joint call with Musk, Hassabis and Altman on September 14 to "pace the frontier," which hit AI stocks at the time, but that predates this week's window and is background rather than new evidence.
indicators.value_display_en: Split continues, Huang pushes back, Trump dismissive
